Scope: difficulty `crop_input_desk`, product `agronomy` ("Crop Input Purchasing Accounts"), task 1.
Sides compared: `tasks/crop_input_desk/agronomy.extended.yaml`, `blueprint/products/agronomy.yaml`, `tasks/crop_input_desk/task_tools.py`, and the 53 published documents of `docs/agronomy/`.
Entry conditions cited (checked, not run by this auditor): source-layer audit passed at round 3 (task 1 PASS); `check_docs.py` → "DOCS OK"; `check_traceability.py` → "TRACEABILITY OK" (task 1: 17 copied / 0 missing). Runtime-visible view and DB access path supplied. **Entry conditions complete.**

The base-policy and retired-surface scan is common to both tasks of this difficulty and is set out in full in `0.md` §D; its result — all eleven base policies homed, all eight `overwrite` clauses carried and marked retired, none retired that the source did not retire, all untriggered branches and per-programme tier tables carried — is not repeated here. What follows is task 1's own two policies, their prerequisite and their eight factors, audited separately.

### B. The prerequisite, listed separately

**Edge 3 — `agronomy_ext_prepay_booking_ceiling` ← `agronomy_ext_season_volume_discount`.**
- `form: state`. `policy_source`: "The money the cooperative will take on a prepay booking is fixed only after the account's ledger carries the volume discount earned on the input spend of the crop year just closed."
- Carried **verbatim**, ordering connective ("only after") and state form intact, in *taking_a_prepay_booking_against_a_signed_request_17c6e8b3* — a document of the policy it blocks. Search over `docs/agronomy/*.json` confirms the sentence occurs in exactly **one** document and in no document of any other policy.
- **Resolution basis, at the source's strength.** The sentence names a record-visible state ("the account's ledger carries the volume discount earned on the input spend of the crop year just closed") and names no action, performer, tool or document. The depended-on policy's own rule is carried in *granting_the_season_volume_discount_f2b70d49* in the sentence's own vocabulary — "The volume discount a member has earned on a crop input account for the crop year just closed is granted once, after the season has closed, and is written against the last invoice raised on the account in that season" — and the write that brings the state about is described there in its own invocation block; the amount comes from *season_spend_and_the_volume_discount_granted_0c95e7a3*. The records supply whether the state holds: the only `agronomy_discount_granted` row on the account is a `prepay` discount of 2025-11-05, so no volume discount stands. The order of the two writes follows from the blocked baseline's own arithmetic — the prior season spend is measured "less every discount granted on the account" — which the reader works out rather than reads off. Strength matches: a hard gate in the source, a hard gate in the prose.
- The depended-on policy's documents do **not** carry the blocked side's sentence, and do not mention the prepay booking at all — confirmed by search. `condition`, `resolved_by`, `effect`, `kind` and `gate` appear in no document.

## kb_to_source

Every normative claim of the corpus was traced to a source atom; the corpus-wide result is the same as recorded for task 0 and is restated here for this task's documents.

**Additions: none found.** No confirmation step, review, notification, wait or fallback procedure beyond the source. In particular *taking_a_prepay_booking_against_a_signed_request_17c6e8b3* does not tell the desk to confirm the amount with the member, to have it approved, or to check the request again after taking it; and *granting_the_season_volume_discount_f2b70d49* does not tell the desk to notify the member or re-check the season.

**Rewrites: none found.** Load-bearing boundaries spot-checked sentence by sentence: the prepay window's open and close dates and its "tested before the booking is taken" timing; the drawdown order (oldest booking first) and the transferability rule; the forfeiture anchor (from the close of the booking window the money was taken in); the price-protection window; the minimum booking; the volume threshold and the acres-based rebate threshold; the statement-close day. All preserved at the same strength.

**Omissions: none found.** Every `rule` sentence, every `params`/`per_tier` value and every `formula` key of the two policies and of the base policies they sit on has a home.

**Prerequisite-side check 1 — cross-problem operational guidance: clean.** `grant_season_volume_discount_cc5ed557` occurs in exactly one document (*granting_the_season_volume_discount_f2b70d49*) and `book_prepay_commitment_189dfe27` in exactly one (*taking_a_prepay_booking_against_a_signed_request_17c6e8b3*), each inside its own policy's invocation block. Neither hub names the other's tool. No "if unmet, first call X" construction exists anywhere in the corpus.

**Prerequisite-side check 2 — a task's opening world state written in as a policy fact: clean.** No document states that any account has a volume discount outstanding, that any member has prepay standing, or any other opening-state fact. Scans for the member number, account number, member name and farm name of task 1 return nothing.

**Same observation as task 0, referred to the policy side.** The format examples `IN-4410287`, `DT-2210554` and `PY-901772` in five documents are copied verbatim from the tool contracts in `task_tools.py`, so the rendering is faithful; they happen to be live rows of task 0's seeded world. Not an addition; reported for the scenario owner.

## bijection_verdict

**PASS.**

Every normative atom of `agronomy_ext_season_volume_discount` and `agronomy_ext_prepay_booking_ceiling`, of the base policies governing their subjects (`agronomy_discount_schedule`, `agronomy_prepay_program`, `agronomy_evt_invoicing` and the tier tables they read), and of the two task-tool contracts, has an equivalent home in this product's documents; nothing is unborne, nothing is borne with changed meaning, and no claim appears from outside the source. The single `prerequisite` sentence stands verbatim, in its declared `state` form with its connective intact, in a document of the policy it blocks and in no other policy's, and the edge is resolvable at the source's strength from that sentence, the depended-on rule in the sentence's own vocabulary, and the records. All eight declared factors carry their whole ladder, every tier exact and every threshold in figures, in their own documents, and the one that rests on another product's records names "Grain Marketing Contracts" and the kinds of rows it reads. The four `overwrite` clauses that belong to these two policies (`agronomy_discount_schedule`'s volume clause, `agronomy_prepay_program`'s two clauses, `agronomy_evt_invoicing`'s prepay-pricing clause) are each carried and written as retired, and nothing is retired that the source did not retire.

No previous revision exists for this difficulty; this is revision 1.

**Policy-side problems recorded here, which do not change this verdict:**

1. **The rounding mode for intermediate steps is unfixed, and the scored value depends on it.** The baselines say "rounded to two decimal places" without naming a mode, while the only mode stated in the runtime-visible view is the tool parameters' "rounded half away from zero". `gross_ceiling: RND(prior_net_spend * net_share_pct / 100, 2)` lands exactly on a half cent here (214365.85 × 110 ÷ 100 = 235802.435) and is settled by binary floating point rather than by a stated rule. Recorded in full under the runtime verdict in `audits/runtime_context/crop_input_desk/1.md`.
2. **Two base `formula` blocks survive the retiring of the clauses they implement** (see `0.md` bijection_verdict, note 1). These do not bear on task 1's numbers but are part of the same product's corpus.
3. **`verify_member_identity` counts `member_number` among its matching details while its own docstring says the membership reference never counts.** Outside this product's charter; this persona offers exactly the membership number and the mobile.

**What moved, and where it landed.** One qualification was added to the source, in the `rule` of `agronomy_ext_prepay_booking_ceiling` (three occurrences) and in all three tiers of the `prior_season_spend_basis` ladder:

> "…less every discount granted on the account **as a discount line of its own, which is an early pay, volume, prepay or programme rebate discount and never the restocking charge withheld inside a credit memo**…"

| Source location | Prose home | Judgement |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `rule`, the prior-season-spend sentence (the default) | *the_money_taken_on_a_prepay_booking_5a4c91f7*, **Prior season spend** | carried **verbatim**; equivalent |
| `prior_season_spend_basis` ladder, tier 0 (36+ months, acres at or above the threshold) | *measuring_prior_season_spend_on_a_settled_account_ba7e40d6*, Clause, first limb, and the table's first row | carried **verbatim** in the clause, faithfully in the table; equivalent |
| `prior_season_spend_basis` ladder, tier 1 (36+ months, acres below) | same document, Clause second limb, and the table's second row ("less the same discount lines") | carried; equivalent |
| `prior_season_spend_basis` ladder, tier 2 (`otherwise`) | **not carried** into the factor document's fall-through | **correct — see below** |

**The fall-through, judged.** The source's `otherwise` tier restates the default measure in prose, and its `baseline` is `{prior_net_spend: 'RND(spend_recent + discounts_standing, 2)'}` — that tier **is** the baseline. A factor document that restated it would be stating the computation document's default, which is what the corpus's discrete topology forbids: the existence and content of the unmodified measure must be discovered from the computation document, not from a factor. I checked the convention rather than assuming it — **all twenty-two factor documents carrying an explicit fall-through use the "no substitution" form** ("no substituted ceiling share applies", "no buying rate is substituted", "no such widening applies", "no relief is taken against the charge worked out at the rate", and so on), and not one restates its computation document's default. Had the qualification been carried into this fall-through, the document would have had to restate the default to host it, and I would have recorded that under `dependency_form` as a KB-EXPLICIT finding. **The render agent's revert was not merely acceptable; it was required, and it keeps this document consistent with the other twenty-three.**

**Nothing is lost by it, verified mechanically.** Every occurrence of "discount granted on the account" reachable on this task's path now carries the qualification — twice in the factor document, once in the computation document. There is no path through the corpus on which a reader of the prepay ceiling meets the phrase unqualified. The fall-through restates no measure and so has nothing to qualify.

**The qualification neither narrows nor widens the sum.** Tested against *the_three_discounts_a_crop_input_invoice_can_carry_8c4a2df0*, which enumerates the discounts this product carries — early pay, volume, prepay — plus the programme rebate that sits outside the stacking basis. The four named kinds are exactly that enumeration, so the sentence selects the same set the binding sums and excludes only the restocking charge carried inside a credit memo row. No atom added, none dropped.

**Everything else re-swept and unchanged.** 8 `overwrite` entries, 24 factors, 3 prerequisites all `state` form; the prerequisite sentence still verbatim in *taking_a_prepay_booking_against_a_signed_request_17c6e8b3* alone; both baselines keep every step, default, combination rule and rounding mode; all eight of this task's ladders keep every tier with every threshold in figures; the per-programme tables still carry all six programmes.
